claims.text: On August 18, 2026, Marvell issued Google LLC a warrant to purchase up to 58,970,907 shares at $206.58 per share, exercisable until August 18, 2033.
1,360,867 shares vest on a quarterly time schedule over year one; 57,610,040 vest in 240 equal tranches of 240,042 shares for each cumulative $500M of Qualifying Revenue through fiscal 2033.
Full vesting requires $120 billion cumulative Qualifying Revenue (240 x $500M).
Aggregate exercise price of the full warrant is approximately $12.18 billion.
Marvell fiscal 2026 (ended Jan 31, 2026) net revenue was $8.2 billion, up 42% from $5.8 billion; top-ten customers were 82% of revenue.
Marvell books customer warrants as a reduction of revenue as the tied revenue vests; fiscal 2025 warrant fair value was $227.6M (Black-Scholes $54.44/share).
Qualifying Revenue excludes contra-revenue impacts from warrant value allocation, so hurdles are measured on gross product revenue.
Marvell shares rose about 10% on August 19, 2026 (close $237.27 from $216.00) while Broadcom fell about 5%.
Marvell's fiscal 2025 customer warrant has been reported by the press as issued to Amazon Web Services for AI procurement; the Google warrant is roughly 14x its share count.
In October 2025 AMD issued OpenAI a warrant for up to 160 million shares (~10% of AMD) at one cent per share alongside a 6-gigawatt GPU supply pact.
Morningstar analyst William Kerwin said Google's chip budget is expanding to accommodate new suppliers rather than displacing Broadcom.
